title: Strong monoidal structure on the inverse of an adjoint equivalence
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ form an adjoint equivalence, with natural isomorphisms $\eta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\cong GF$ and $\epsilon:FG\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$ satisfying the two triangle identities. Suppose $F$ has a specified strong monoidal structure [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], with $e_F:\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}\cong F\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}$ and $c^F_{X,Y}:F(X\otimes Y)\cong FX\otimes FY$. There is a strong monoidal structure on $G$, with maps $e_G:\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\cong G\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$ and $\mu^G_{U,V}:GU\otimes GV\cong G(U\otimes V)$, satisfying
$$G(e_F^{-1})\circ\eta_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=e_G,$$
$$G(c^F_{X,Y})\circ\eta_{X\otimes Y}=\mu^G_{FX,FY}\circ(\eta_X\otimes\eta_Y),$$
$$\epsilon_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}}\circ F(e_G)=e_F^{-1},$$
$$\epsilon_{U\otimes V}\circ F(\mu^G_{U,V})=(\epsilon_U\otimes\epsilon_V)\circ c^F_{GU,GV}.$$
Here equations denote forward morphisms, and composition is right to left.
